[element-issn]
=== `<issn>` ISSN (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), the International Standard Serial Number, the international code that uniquely identifies a serial publication title.

#### Usage/Remarks
The format/medium type of a particular <<element-issn,`<issn>`>> can be captured using the <<attribute-publication-format,`@publication-format`>> attribute.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-originator,`@originator`>>
* <<attribute-pub-type,`@pub-type`>>
* <<attribute-publication-format,`@publication-format`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
